title: Key Lime Fresh Vietnamese Pecorino Pho
description: A springy, energizing Vietnamese dish featuring pecorino, long-fermentation-dough, and a hint of key lime. Perfect for a warm morning breakfast or a light dinner.
instructions: Combine broth, key lime juice, fish sauce, and lime zest in a large pot. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Add the long-fermentation-dough strips and cook for 2 minutes, or until slightly softened.
Stir in the coconut milk and pecorino cheese until melted and smooth.
Add sliced chili peppers and scallions, and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve immediately over noodles or rice.
Garnish with additional scallions, chili peppers, and key lime wedges if desired.
Refrigerate or freeze for later use.
Store leftovers in an airtight container for up to 3 days.
